messages:
eli: Quick heads-up — onboarding sample app (js-sdk) started getting weird 429 spikes when users paginate through embeddings.
eli: Repro steps: open onboarding flow, click `Generate` repeatedly to page results, then token refresh kicks in and a bunch of requests go out at once.
maya: ugh. do you have logs? sounds like a retry/backoff coordination bug between pagination + auth refresh.
eli: logging snippet:
```
2024-06-15T14:00:01Z INFO request id=abc123 endpoint=/embeddings page=2 status=200
2024-06-15T14:00:03Z INFO token refresh start
2024-06-15T14:00:03Z WARN retry send id=def456 endpoint=/embeddings page=3 status=429
2024-06-15T14:00:03Z WARN retry send id=ghi789 endpoint=/embeddings page=4 status=429
```
eli: looks like when refresh happens we re-enqueue in-flight pagination requests without respecting the SDK's client-side throttle window.
sam: which SDK? js? go? both?
eli: js-sdk (sample app uses react + our js-sdk). I quickly checked go-sdk example and it does single-flight auth refresh, js doesn't.
maya: that explains parity issue. js is re-sending N requests after refresh because each request sees auth expired and triggers a refresh+retry instead of awaiting the in-progress refresh.
lena: @maya can you confirm the expected behavior? iirc we recommend a single-flight refresh + shared promise to avoid thundering herd.
maya: yes — expected: first request wins refresh, others await the same new token. if a request still gets a 401 after refresh, then it should retry with exponential backoff and jitter, not immediate re-enqueue for pagination window.
eli: quick patch i prototyped in the sample app to demonstrate the fix — add an authLock promise and a small jitter before retry. code:
```
let authLock = null;
async function ensureToken() {
  if (authLock) return authLock;
  authLock = (async () => { await refreshToken(); authLock = null; })();
  return authLock;
}

// when 401 returned:
await ensureToken();
await sleep(randomBetween(20,80)); // jitter ms
return retryOriginalRequest();
```
sam: nice. does that reduce the burst?
eli: yes locally it collapsed ~90% of duplicate retries in the scenario.
maya: good demo. we should push this into the js-sdk core (auth layer) and add a small default jitter behind retry. also add test covering concurrent pagination + token expiration.
lena: patch should include a feature flag? i worry about changing retry semantics for other customers.
maya: we can ship behind a minor opt-in flag for now and default to enabled for sample apps and new installs. also update docs in devex onboarding quickstart.
sam: also check our streaming path — single-flight plus streaming chunked requests might have different constraints.
eli: yes streaming uses a different auth path, filed a follow-up issue.
dev-rel-bot: Note: Created ticket INFR-4172 "js-sdk: add single-flight auth refresh + jitter to prevent pagination retry storms" assigned to @maya, priority P2.
eli: thanks — i'll iterate on the sample app PR and include perf numbers.
maya: can you also capture a heap of metrics: 429 rate, retry-origin (auth vs rate-limit), and per-page latency pre/post patch?
eli: on it. will post numbers in this thread once I have them. :thumbsup:
